name: FurrHouse
source: FurrHouse is a semi-harem vn with meaningful choices. In short you'll have to run a house with six hot monster girls. You can play as a man or as a woman(futanari). Often you will have to make choices that affect the attitude of girls towards you and the personality of your character. If you spoil your relationship with one of the girls and she decides to leave home, the game will stop and you will get an alternative ending (that will depends on your points). You can also form an alliance with one of the three other houses (sand demons, elves, and dark ones).
translation: FurrHouse是一个半后宫vn，有有意义的选择。简而言之，你必须经营一个拥有六个性感怪物女孩的房子。你可以扮演男性或女性（futanari）。通常，你必须做出的选择会影响女孩对你的态度以及你的角色个性。如果你破坏了与其中一个女孩的关系，并且她决定离开家，游戏将停止，你将得到另一个结局（这取决于你的分数）。你还可以与其他三个家族（沙恶魔、精灵和黑暗家族）之一结成联盟。
